revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Lin11 yes. Lin12 traces of a Nu are not really very clear, but it is clear that there has been a fold in the papyrus at this point. The space between the epsilon and epsilon is greater than one might expect. A closing Nu would be preferable especially in the light of the newly proposed Nu in lins21/22. Thus I think it better to accept the dotted Nu as a reading in the text. lin18 both new readings are clear and an improvement. Lin21/22 yes. δεκάτου with heavy Verschleifung is the better reading and the restored (ἔτους) would be required and there is space for it.
